concept.en: The net survives losing its control station

summary.hr: NCS zašuti usred prometa. Unaprijed imenovani zamjenski NCS, koji je slušao i vodio zapis, nakon 60 s tišine preuzima i nastavlja od prve nepredane poruke.
summary.en: The NCS falls silent mid-traffic. The pre-named backup NCS, which listened and kept a log, takes over after 60 s of silence and resumes the queue.

concept.hr: 60 s tišine, objava preuzimanja, nastavak od stanice C: 5 poruka u 15 odsječaka
concept.en: 60 s of silence, a takeover, resumed at station C: all 5 messages in 15 slots

concept.hr: Nitko nije imenovan: mreža se gasi, predane su 2 od 5 poruka
concept.en: Nobody was named: the net shuts down, 2 of 5 messages delivered

concept.hr: Preuzimanje nakon 15 s, NCS se vraća: dvije kontrolne stanice dupliraju
concept.en: Takeover after 15 s, the NCS comes back: two control stations double

concept.hr: Zamjena bez vlastitog zapisa ponavlja javljanje: 20 odsječaka umjesto 15
concept.en: A backup without its own log re-runs the check-in: 20 slots instead of 15
